name: Prophet
overview: Scripture teaches that God will raise up a prophet from among the people, one like Moses, who will faithfully deliver God's words to His people as commanded (Deuteronomy 18:15,18). This prophet speaks only what God commands, and any who presume to speak falsely in God's name or promote other gods face severe judgment (Deuteronomy 18:20). Thus, the role of a true prophet is defined by divine calling and obedience to God's revelation.
